beats.headline: Too small, and borrowed
beats.text: Donut is up the tree outside the window, howling. Carl's boots are in the dryer in the building's basement and he doesn't know where his running shoes are, so he squeezes his feet into a pair of his ex-girlfriend's Crocs, pulls on a heavy leather jacket and rushes outside for the cat. When the floating words appear in front of him he kicks at them, and the too-small Croc goes flying; he hops over and shoves his foot back in. The fire is further away than he thought. He turns toward the light, and he runs.

beats.headline: Both of them, flying
beats.text: In the dungeon, Carl takes a step forward, painfully aware that the Crocs don't fit. He steps into a pitch-black alley and earns an achievement for falling into an obvious trap. Three lights flip on, something mechanical hisses and roars like a steam engine, and there is high-pitched laughter. He turns and runs, and both of his pink Crocs go flying as he turns down the main tunnel. Donut yowls and rushes after him. Behind them, the goblin murder dozer rockets out of the alleyway.
